James Finaly Plc. Chittagong ------ Appellant
vs
Government of Bangladesh and others  ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 5. Mr Md Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the appellant submit-ted that no Rule was issued upon the Chittagong Port Authority and its officers although the High Court Division upon perusing the affidavit-in-opposition filed by the respondent No.2, Chairman, Chittagong Port Authority in the instant writ petition and upon hearing the respondent No.2 declared the impugned letter Memo No. CR/SRD/Various vessels/85 dated 05/07,06.1989 communicating the decision of the Board of Trustees of the Chittagong Port Authority by the respondent No. 3 to the appellant as illegal; that the High Court Division acted illegally in not making, the Rule absolute on the ground of non-issuance of Rule upon the Chittagong Port Authority or its officers whereas the respondent No. 2 caused their appearance in the instant writ petition; that the High Court Division erred in not allowing the prayer of the appellant for time to amend the prayer portion of the petition of inclusion of the name of the other respondents for issuance of a Rule along with the respondent No. 1 whose name was not included in the prayer portion of the petition. The learned Advocate further submitted that the High Court Division after considering the writ petition and the affidavit-in-opposition on behalf of the respondent No. 2 found the impugned order illegal on merit but discharged the Rule on the ground of non-issuance of a Rule upon the Chittagong Port Authority or its officers where-as the respondent No. 2 caused appearance in the writ petition and filed affidavit-in-opposition and argued the case when the impugned letter No. CR/SRD/Various vessels/85 dated 5-7-6-1989 was declared as illegal which needs interference by this Division for setting-aside the judgment and order dated 24-2-1997 of the High Court Division and for appropriate directions.
